title: Gaussian Max-Cut constant identity
statement: Let $\theta_*$ be the infimum of the angles $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ satisfying $\tan(\theta/2)=\theta$, and let $c_*$ be the infimum of $(\theta/\pi)/((1-\cos\theta)/2)$ over $0<\theta\leq\pi$. Then $c_*=(\theta_*/\pi)/((1-\cos\theta_*)/2)$.
